title: Full Stack Developer (Laravel + Vue.Js)
jobDescription:
Job Description:

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and implement Backend components using Laravel ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using Vue.js. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Familiarity with database technologies such as My SQL, Postgre SQL, or Mongo DB. Knowledge of RESTful APIs and web services. Troubleshoot and debug technical issues. Participate in daily stand up meeting with Clients Requirements: Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role. Solid understanding of web development fundamentals (HTML, CSS, Java Script). Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Strong attention to detail Should be comfortable doing client interaction on daily basis. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]

title: Golang Developer
jobDescription: Job Description: Responsibilities Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in Golang for Backend development. Develop user interfaces using React and ensure the responsiveness and performance of applications. Knowledge of Node/Angular/Js technology, will be a plus point. Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability. Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers. Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure smooth operation of software applications. Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in Golang and React development Experience with database technologies such as SQL and No SQL databases. Involve in daily stand up calls Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). Experience having client interaction. Proven experience as a Golang Developer with a strong portfolio of past projects. Knowledge of other frontend frameworks such as Angular or Vue.js. Proficiency in frontend development using React and related libraries/tools. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and micro services architecture. Experience with database technologies such as SQL and No SQL databases. Knowledge of Python technology, will be a plus point. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]

title: Wordpress Developer
jobDescription:
Job Description:

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and Cutomize Word Press themes and plugins from scratch, adhering to best practices and coding standards. Excellent proficiency on OOPs, PHP, My Sql, Ajax, JQuery. Experience with Word Press coding standard [hooks and filters] Integrate Woo Commerce functionality into Word Press websites and Optimising website performance, responsiveness, and security. Proficient understanding of RESTful APIs and formats(JSON, XML) and code versioning tools (such as Git, SVN, and Mercurial). Interacting with clients on regular basis will be must. Requirements Minimum 5 yrs of experience in building web applications. Relevant Education/qualification. Expertise in Word Press with Plugin Development (Woo Commerce ) and theme customization. Good understanding of front-end technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, Java Script, j Query will be an advantage Excellent Communication skills Collaborate with designers and content creators to implement website designs and layouts. Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring seamless functionality across different browsers and devices. Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in Word Press and Woo Commerce development. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]
